title: WeaponType
description: Data schema for a top-level Legendary Weapon Type classification in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

id.description: Unique identifier for the weapon type (e.g., 'CW_WT_SWORD', 'CW_WT_SHIELD').

name.description: Display name of the weapon type.

description.description: Summary description of the weapon type category.

iconAsset.description: Path to visual icon asset used in UI.

baseSeriesIds.description: List of default Series IDs associated with this Weapon Type.
